Skeledirge

Fire Ghost

Paldea · Generation 9

Skeledirge is a Fire/Ghost-type Singer Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 326.5 kg. It evolves from Crocalor. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (110), with a base stat total of 530.
